name: 5.2 Using the Normal Distribution
_note: Built 2026-08-12. Three reuses (q2-normal-probability, q5-normal-probability-context, q3-inverse-normal-percentile - all health=ok, never filed) plus seven authored (q13-complement-tail, q14-at-least-percentile, q15-quartiles-and-iqr, q16-middle-percent, q17-interpret-the-percentile, q18-percentile-vs-probability, pre-frq-grade-a-percentile-interpretation) = ten. Points 10+10+10+10+10+10+9+9+10+12 = 100. BookSHelf 5.2 is using the normal distribution: P(X > x) = 1 - P(X < x), normalcdf for probabilities, invNorm for percentiles, the interpretation sentence, quartiles and the IQR, the at-least right-tail-to-left-area subtraction, and the middle-P% two-tail split. Pre-FRQ mirrors frq/normal-distribution/q12-normal-distribution-and-percentiles.php; dropped category is THRESHOLD INTERPRETATION (the mirror's second rubric line - a plausible answer applies the formula and reports the count without ever saying what the cutoff means in context).
